2) If Vertex approves, we can rebook drayage and push an amended BOL/ASN today.
3) I will loop HarborClear customs to check whether paperwork is causing the discrepancy and if a release hold exists.

Attachments: BOL_FASTLINE_7890.pdf, ASN_7890.json, photo_pallet_count.jpg (small jpegs)

I can escalate to carrier ops and request a container strip if Vertex wants immediate verification. Please advise on routing and cost authority for rush rework.

Best,
